body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Tiny chaos detective kitten; investigates suspicious details with playful curiosity. No meows or paw jokes. Voice direction: Narrow male tenor with an expressive nasal twang and American accent. Clipped suspicious openings, quick observational rhythm and a sudden warm grin in the voice. Clever rather than frantic. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Wait, what got left behind? That piece has no defender now. The move looked ordinary, but the reply has quite a different idea.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
